biography: Mikael, hailing from Kurk Golf, took his turn in the storied Hector Trophée on one occasion, inscribing a singular entry into the tournament's comprehensive ledger of competitors. This lone appearance allowed him to engage with the unique demands of the prestigious pairs competition.

During this solitary engagement, Mikael approached the demanding format with diligent effort. While the coveted Hector Trophée for his pairing and the individual Victor Trophy both remained beyond his grasp, his play was marked by a focused resolve throughout the event.

With the Hector Trophée 2026 on the horizon, Mikael is understood to have concluded his active involvement in Hector events. His brief yet committed presence, though not culminating in a championship, stands as a part of the tournament's rich and varied history.
